turns.input: Pellan gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Pellan fumbles with something tucked under his arm, producing a pair of worn leather boots that look as shabby as the rest of him. "These, I—" he starts, then stops to push his spectacles up his nose with his ink-stained fingers. "I found them. Not stole. Found. Behind the Registry, in a crate meant for the poorhouse, but they were too large for anyone there and I thought—" He thrusts them toward Nicco with an anxious glance up at his face, then quickly away. "You look like you might fit them. If you want them. I don't want anything for them, I just—" He trails off, shuffling his feet.

He waits with obvious discomfort, boots extended, clearly eager to be rid of both the item and the social situation.

Nicco takes the boots from him.

turns.narration:
"They were meant for the poorhouse," Pellan repeats, spectacles catching the pale daylight as he shakes his head. "For someone who needs them. Not for me." He offers a thin, anxious smile, hands clasped before him as if to keep from fidgeting. "Please. Take them."

He makes no move to accept the boots back.
